033/** The jessop ScriptEngine class.

037public class JessopScriptEngine extends AbstractScriptEngine implements Compilable {
038
039        /** Logger instance for this class */
040        Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(JessopScriptEngine.class);
041
042        /** ScriptEngineFactory that created this class */
043        ScriptEngineFactory factory;
044
045        /** If set during compile(), holds the externally-provided polyglot Engine so that
046         * closeTargetEngine() knows not to close it. */
047        private Engine graalEngine;
048        
049    /** Reserved key for a named value that identifies the initial language used for jessop scripts.
050     * If not set, will default to 'javascript'
051     */
052        public static final String JESSOP_LANGUAGE = "com.randommoun.common.jessop.language";
053        
054        /** Default value for the JESSOP_LANGUAGE key; has the value "javascript" */
055        public static final String JESSOP_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE = "javascript";
056        
057    /** Reserved key for a named value that identifies the initial ScriptEngine used for jessop scripts.
058     * If not set, will use the default engine for the default language.
059     */
060        public static final String JESSOP_ENGINE = "com.randommoun.common.jessop.engine";
061
062        /** Default value for the JESSOP_ENGINE key; has the value "graal-js" */
063        public static final String JESSOP_DEFAULT_ENGINE = "graal-js";
064        
065        
066    /** Reserved key for a named value that sets the initial exception converter.
067     * If not set, will use the default converter for the default language
068     */
069        public static final String JESSOP_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER = "com.randommoun.common.jessop.exceptionConverter";
070
071        /** Default value for the JESSOP_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER key; has the value null */
072        public static String JESSOP_DEFAULT_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER = "com.randomnoun.common.jessop.engine.graaljs.GraalJsExceptionConverter";
073
074    /** Reserved key for a named value that sets the initial bindings converter.
075     * If not set, will use the default converter for the default language
076     */
077        public static final String JESSOP_BINDINGS_CONVERTER = "com.randommoun.common.jessop.bindingsConverter";
078
079        /** Default value for the JESSOP_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER key; has the value null */
080        // so this isn't final any more, since it might change depending on what's on the classpath
081        public static String JESSOP_DEFAULT_BINDINGS_CONVERTER = "com.randomnoun.common.jessop.engine.graaljs.GraalJsBindingsConverter";
082
083        static {
084                JavascriptJessopScriptBuilder jjsb = new JavascriptJessopScriptBuilder(); 
085                JESSOP_DEFAULT_BINDINGS_CONVERTER = jjsb.getDefaultBindingsConverterClassName();
086                JESSOP_DEFAULT_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER = jjsb.getDefaultExceptionConverterClassName();
087        }
088        
089        
090    /** Reserved key for a named value that controls whether the target script is compiled
091     * (providing the target engine allows it).
092     * If not set, will default to 'false'.
093     */
094        public static final String JESSOP_COMPILE_TARGET = "com.randommoun.common.jessop.compileTarget";
095
096        /** Default value for the JESSOP_COMPILE_TARGET key; has the value "false" */
097        public static final String JESSOP_DEFAULT_COMPILE_TARGET = "false";
098
099        
100    /** Reserved key for a named value that controls whether the target script 
101     * will have EOLs suppressed after scriptlets that appear at the end of a line.
102     * If not set, will default to 'false'.
103     */
104        public static final String JESSOP_SUPPRESS_EOL = "com.randommoun.common.jessop.suppressEol";
105
106        /** Default value for the JESSOP_SUPPRESS_EOL key; has the value "false" */
107        public static final String JESSOP_DEFAULT_SUPPRESS_EOL = "false";
108
109    /** Reserved key for a named value that provides a shared {@code org.graalvm.polyglot.Engine}
110     * instance. If set, the jessop engine will create new Contexts within this Engine rather than
111     * creating a new Engine per evaluation. The caller is responsible for closing this Engine.
112     */
113        public static final String JESSOP_GRAAL_ENGINE = "com.randomnoun.common.jessop.graalEngine";
114
115
116        // so I guess we implement this twice then
117        // let's always compile it if we can
118        
119        /** {@inheritDoc} */
120        @Override
121        public Object eval(String script, ScriptContext context) throws ScriptException {
122                CompiledScript cscript = compile(script);
123                try {
124                        return cscript.eval(context);
125                } finally {
126                        closeTargetEngine(cscript.getEngine());
127                }
128        }
129
130        /** {@inheritDoc} */
131        @Override
132        public Object eval(Reader reader, ScriptContext context) throws ScriptException {
133                CompiledScript cscript = compile(reader);
134                try {
135                        return cscript.eval(context);
136                } finally {
137                        closeTargetEngine(cscript.getEngine());
138                }
139        }
140
141        // if the user doesn't supply a context, we evaluate it with a null context (not the default context)
142        // the JessopCompiledScript will then use the appropriate language's default context instead
143        
144        /** {@inheritDoc} */
145        @Override
146        public Object eval(String script) throws ScriptException {
147        return eval(script, (ScriptContext) null);
148    }
149
150        /** {@inheritDoc} */
151        @Override
152        public Object eval(Reader reader) throws ScriptException {
153        return eval(reader, (ScriptContext) null);
154    }
155
156        private void closeTargetEngine(ScriptEngine targetEngine) {
157                if (targetEngine instanceof GraalJSScriptEngine) {
158                        GraalJSScriptEngine graalJsEngine = (GraalJSScriptEngine) targetEngine;
159                        Engine polyglotEngine = graalJsEngine.getPolyglotContext().getEngine();
160                        graalJsEngine.close();
161                        if (this.graalEngine == null) {
162                                polyglotEngine.close();
163                        }
164                } else if (targetEngine instanceof AutoCloseable) {
165                        try { ((AutoCloseable) targetEngine).close(); } catch (Exception e) { /* ignore */ }
166                }
167        }
168
169        /** {@inheritDoc} */
170        @Override
171        public Bindings createBindings() {
172                return new SimpleBindings();
173        }
174
175        /** {@inheritDoc} */
176        @Override
177        public ScriptEngineFactory getFactory() {
178                if (factory != null) {
179                        return factory;
180                } else {
181                        return new JessopScriptEngineFactory();
182                }
183        }
184        
185        // package private; called by ScriptEngineFactory only
186        void setEngineFactory(ScriptEngineFactory fac) {
187                factory = fac;
188        }
189
190        @Override
191        /** {@inheritDoc} */
192        public CompiledScript compile(String script) throws ScriptException {
193                return compile(new StringReader(script));
194        }
195
196        /** {@inheritDoc} */
197        @Override
198        public CompiledScript compile(Reader script) throws ScriptException {
199                try {
200                        // if (initialLanguage == null) { initialLanguage = "javascript"; }
201
202                        JessopDeclarations declarations = new JessopDeclarations();
203                        // jessop defaults
204                        declarations.setEngine(JESSOP_DEFAULT_ENGINE);
205                        declarations.setExceptionConverter(JESSOP_DEFAULT_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER);
206                        declarations.setBindingsConverter(JESSOP_DEFAULT_BINDINGS_CONVERTER);
207                        declarations.setCompileTarget(Boolean.valueOf(JESSOP_DEFAULT_COMPILE_TARGET));
208                        declarations.setSuppressEol(Boolean.valueOf(JESSOP_DEFAULT_SUPPRESS_EOL));
209
210                        // ScriptEngine defaults
211                        String filename = (String) get(ScriptEngine.FILENAME);
212                        String initialLanguage = (String) get(JessopScriptEngine.JESSOP_LANGUAGE);
213                        String initialEngine = (String) get(JessopScriptEngine.JESSOP_ENGINE);
214                        String initialExceptionConverter = (String) get(JessopScriptEngine.JESSOP_EXCEPTION_CONVERTER);
215                        String initialBindingsConverter = (String) get(JessopScriptEngine.JESSOP_BINDINGS_CONVERTER);
216                        String initialCompileTarget = (String) get(JessopScriptEngine.JESSOP_COMPILE_TARGET);
217                        String initialSuppressEol = (String) get(JessopScriptEngine.JESSOP_SUPPRESS_EOL);
218                        if (initialLanguage==null) { initialLanguage = JESSOP_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE; }
219                        if (filename!=null) { declarations.setFilename(filename); }
220                        if (initialEngine!=null) { declarations.setEngine(initialEngine); }
221                        if (initialExceptionConverter!=null) { declarations.setExceptionConverter(initialExceptionConverter); }
222                        if (initialBindingsConverter!=null) { declarations.setBindingsConverter(initialBindingsConverter); }
223                        if (initialCompileTarget!=null) { declarations.setCompileTarget(Boolean.valueOf(initialCompileTarget)); }
224                        if (initialSuppressEol!=null) { declarations.setSuppressEol(Boolean.valueOf(initialSuppressEol)); }
225                        
226                        ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); 
227                        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(baos);
228                    // new JavascriptJessopScriptBuilder(); // default for now
229                        JessopScriptBuilder jsb = ((JessopScriptEngineFactory) getFactory()).getJessopScriptBuilderForLanguage(initialLanguage);
230                        jsb.setPrintWriter(pw);
231                        Tokeniser t = new Tokeniser(this, jsb);
232                        jsb.setTokeniserAndDeclarations(t, declarations);
233                        
234                        // tokenise the script
235                        int ch = script.read();
236                        while (ch!=-1) {
237                                t.parseChar((char) ch);
238                                ch = script.read();
239                        }
240                        t.parseEndOfFile();
241                        pw.flush();
242                        
243                        // get the output from the PrintWriter
244                        String newScript = baos.toString();
245                        
246                        // the final JSB contains the final declarations that were in effect 
247                        declarations = t.jsb.getDeclarations();
248                        
249                        // get this from the jessop declaration eventally, but for now:
250                        // if the underlying engine supports compilation, then compile that here, otherwise just store the source
251                        ScriptEngine engine;
252                        if ("graalEngine".equals(declarations.engine)) {
253                                Object graalEngineObj = get(JESSOP_GRAAL_ENGINE);
254                                if (!(graalEngineObj instanceof Engine)) {
255                                        throw new ScriptException("engine 'graalEngine' requires a " + JESSOP_GRAAL_ENGINE + " attribute");
256                                }
257                                Engine polyglotEngine = (Engine) graalEngineObj;
258                                this.graalEngine = polyglotEngine;
259                                engine = GraalJSScriptEngine.create(polyglotEngine,
260                                        Context.newBuilder("js")
261                                                .engine(polyglotEngine)
262                                                .allowHostAccess(HostAccess.ALL)
263                                                .allowHostClassLookup(s -> true));
264                        } else if ("graal-js".equals(declarations.engine) || "graal.js".equals(declarations.engine)) {
265                                Engine polyglotEngine = Engine.newBuilder()
266                                        .option("engine.WarnInterpreterOnly", "false")
267                                        .build();
268                                this.graalEngine = null;
269                                engine = GraalJSScriptEngine.create(polyglotEngine,
270                                        Context.newBuilder("js")
271                                                .engine(polyglotEngine)
272                                                .allowHostAccess(HostAccess.ALL)
273                                                .allowHostClassLookup(s -> true));
274                        } else {
275                                engine = new ScriptEngineManager().getEngineByName(declarations.engine);
276                        }
277                        if (engine==null) {
278                                throw new ScriptException("java.scriptx engine '" + declarations.engine + "' not found");
279                        }
280                        
281                        JessopBindingsConverter jbc = null;
282                        if (declarations.bindingsConverter !=null && !declarations.bindingsConverter.equals("")) {
283                                try {
284                                        jbc = (JessopBindingsConverter) 
285                                                Class.forName(declarations.bindingsConverter).newInstance();
286                                } catch (Exception e) {
287                                        throw (ScriptException) new ScriptException(
288                                          "bindingsConverter '" + declarations.bindingsConverter + "' not loaded").initCause(e);
289                                }
290                        }
291                        
292                        JessopExceptionConverter jec = null;
293                        if (declarations.exceptionConverter!=null && !declarations.exceptionConverter.equals("")) {
294                                try {
295                                        jec = (JessopExceptionConverter) 
296                                                Class.forName(declarations.exceptionConverter).newInstance();
297                                } catch (Exception e) {
298                                        throw (ScriptException) new ScriptException(
299                                          "exceptionConverter '" + declarations.exceptionConverter + "' not loaded").initCause(e);
300                                }
301                        }
302                         
303                        // com.sun.script.javascript.RhinoScriptEngine m = (com.sun.script.javascript.RhinoScriptEngine) engine;
304                        // the newScript is compiled here, if the engine supports it
305                        return new JessopCompiledScript(engine, declarations.isCompileTarget(), 
306                                declarations.getFilename(), newScript, jec, jbc);
307                        
308                } catch (IOException ioe) {
309                        throw new ScriptException(ioe);
310                }
311                
312                
313                
314        }
315}
